verdict.rationale: Resend's core product is a documented Email API with a dedicated send-email endpoint (resend-docs-1), described as 'a simple, modern API' for developers (resend-docs-22/29), and multiple hands-on community accounts praise the quick, low-friction developer experience (resend-comm-1, resend-comm-5, resend-comm-13). Probes confirm live docs/OpenAPI spec (resend-probe-1/2/3). Missing for 10: explicit copy-paste quickstart code snippet and confirmation that the response returns a trackable message id are not directly quoted in the evidence pack, only implied by the API's existence.
